description.en: One figure per scene, held large and counted up.
description.vi: Mỗi cảnh một con số, để thật lớn và đếm lên.

script.guidance: Every scene is one figure and what it means. Put the figure in `number` and its unit or subject in `label`; the narration says what the figure tells us, never the digits alone. A scene that compares things puts each side in `entries` with its own number and label.

draw.guidance: The figure is the picture: set it at a size that leaves room for nothing else — a quarter of the frame's height or more — with its label small and quiet beneath it. A scene with entries becomes a row or column of bars, one per entry, each bar labelled and carrying its own number at the end. Keep the axis implicit: no grid, no ticks, no legend.
motion: Every figure counts up from zero: tl.add(nodecine.count('.number', { duration: 1.1, ease: 'power2.out' }), 0.2) — the number is never simply revealed already written.
Bars grow from nothing along their own length, staggered a tenth of a second apart, easing out; the bar and the number it belongs to finish together.
The figure holds still and full for the rest of the scene once it has counted: a number the eye cannot rest on cannot be read.
The one figure the scene is about is the only thing in the accent colour; everything compared with it stays quiet.
